audience: salespeople who track leads through a pipeline in noCRM.io

useCases.title: List open leads in a pipeline step
useCases.text: The AI lists leads by status and step with amount, probability, owner and next reminder, and adds up what they are worth.

useCases.title: Read the history and comments of a lead
useCases.text: The AI reads the comments of a lead and its timeline of assignments, step and status changes, amount changes and emails.

useCases.title: Find unassigned and duplicate leads
useCases.text: The AI lists leads that have no owner yet, and finds possible duplicates of a lead.

useCases.title: Create a lead and assign it
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead with the contact details in the description, and assigns it to a user by id or email.

useCases.title: Update a lead and add a comment
useCases.text: The AI marks a lead won, lost or on standby, moves it to another step, changes the amount or tags, and adds a note such as a call.

useCases.title: Group leads in client folders
useCases.text: The AI creates a client folder and files a lead under it, or reads existing folders.
